title: limodorum oreganum
intro: Limodorum oreganum, commonly known as Oreganum, is a type of orchid that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine and is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and boosting the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Limodorum oreganum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, that exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential uses.
